## Files included in SWS

All SVG files are in `sws-editor/public/images/equinor/`.
They are served at runtime under `/images/equinor/<filename>.svg`.

The full symbol set was downloaded (~200 symbols covering ISO 10628 /
ISA-5.1 process engineering: valves, pumps, vessels, instruments, piping,
heat exchangers, etc.).

## Modifications

File names may have been normalized to lowercase with hyphens (replacing
underscores or spaces) during the download step. No graphical modifications
have been made.
